name: Prism Importer

optional_imports.name: Pokemon Diamond, Pearl or Platinum (.nds)
optional_imports.description: Any region. Platinum has the most: its extra forms, trainers and people. Battle sprites, trainer pictures and overworld sprites are pulled out once, in the background while you play.

optional_imports.name: Pokemon HeartGold or SoulSilver (.nds)
optional_imports.description: Any region. Battle sprites, trainer pictures, overworld sprites and all the walking Pokemon are pulled out once, in the background while you play.

optional_imports.name: Pokemon Black 2 or White 2 (.nds)
optional_imports.description: Any region, including NDSi-enhanced dumps. Animated battle sprites, trainer pictures and overworld sprites are pulled out once, in the background while you play.

description: Sprites from your own Diamond, Pearl, Platinum, HeartGold, SoulSilver, Black 2 and White 2 dumps, for other mods to use: battle sprites, trainer pictures, overworld sprites and HeartGold/SoulSilver's walking Pokemon. Nothing from the games ships with it.
